items.title: Aebersold Jamey — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Right now, we’re getting ready to do a Chick Corea Play-A-Long. We finally got the rights to some of the tunes.

ctx.x: So were there any bumps along the way?

Oh yeah. Bumps. A lot of bumps. But you just work across them. Right now, we’re getting ready to do a Chick Corea Play-A-Long. We finally got the rights to some of the tunes. We’ve been asking for several years to get the rights. Finally, we’re doing that. I’ve got other projects here that I’d love to do, but you can only do so much at a time. The slowing some of these down has been the best thing in a long time, I think.
That’s just within the last five years?
